title: Foods sticks to mine
text:
Foods sticks to mine. Perhaps I got one from a bad batch. I love silicone bakeware & own a number of pieces. I ordered this because of the metal rim/handles, inside the silicone.
I used this once, to bake sausages & it was a baked on mess when I took it out of the oven. I tried scrapping with a PamperedCheff scraper & it only removed about 80% of the mess.
I am throwing this out because I don’t trust it. None of my food grade silicone baking pans ever stick, ever. And I have used them over & over again.
Like I said, perhaps this came from a bad manufacturing batch
